statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The value was directly available as a single line item in the primary cash flow statement under 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities'. All other fields from the schema were omitted as they were not requested. The supplementary tables contain detailed breakdowns for operating leases and parent company cash flows, but these were not required for the requested field.
